name: Mustard and Thyme Lamb Chops
description: Pan-seared lamb chops are coated in a mixture of Dijon mustard and fresh thyme before being finished under the broiler. The meat is accompanied by mashed yellow potatoes mixed with roasted hemp seeds and Swiss chard sautéed in a garlic-infused demi-glace. This preparation combines savory and tangy flavors with the nutty texture of hemp seeds and the earthy profile of the greens.

description: This stovetop dish consists of macaroni tossed in a roux-based sauce made with milk, sharp orange cheddar, and parmesan cheese. A small amount of pizza sauce is incorporated into the mixture to add a mild tomato flavor to the traditional cheese base.

name: Burgers de porc et mozzarella avec poivrons rôtis et salade de carottes miel-Dijon

name: Grilled Thai Coconut Chicken Skewers
description: These skewers consist of chicken thighs marinated in a mixture of coconut milk, red curry paste, ginger, garlic, and spices such as turmeric and coriander. This preparation results in a savory profile balanced by creamy coconut and notes of lime and cilantro.

name: Muffins aux carottes
description: These carrot muffins are prepared by combining a spiced flour base with a mixture of eggs, brown sugar, and canola oil. name: Sandwich fromage grillé : Brie, poireaux, bacon
description: This grilled sandwich consists of crusty Belgian bread filled with Brie cheese, sautéed leeks, and crispy bacon. The leeks are cooked until tender before being layered with the cheese and bacon between buttered slices of bread. The sandwich is then pan-grilled until the exterior is toasted and the Brie is melted.

description: This 15-minute dish features fresh penne rigate tossed in a creamy sauce composed of mascarpone, sun-dried tomato pesto, and vegetable demi-glace. Cuire le bœuf", "@type": "HowToSection", "itemListElement": [{"text": "Dans une grande poêle, chauffer un filet d'huile d'olive à feu moyen-vif. Ajouter le bœuf* et ½ des épices; S-P. Cuire 5 à 6 min, en brisant la viande, jusqu'à ce qu'il soit doré et bien cuit. Transférer dans un bol; laisser les sucs dans la poêle. Réserver la poêle.", "@type": "HowToStep"}]}, {"name": "3. Faire la garniture", "@type": "HowToSection", "itemListElement": [{"text": "Chauffer la même poêle à feu moyen (ajouter un filet d'huile d'olive au besoin). Ajouter l'ail et faire sauter 30 sec à 1 min, jusqu'à ce que ce soit parfumé. Ajouter la chair de zucchinis et les épices restantes; S-P. Faire sauter 3 à 4 min, en grattant pour décoller les sucs, jusqu'à qu'elle ait ramolli. Ajouter la sauce tomate et le bœuf. Cuire 2 à 3 min, en remuant parfois, jusqu'à ce que ce soit mélangé; S-P.", "@type": "HowToStep"}]}, {"name": "4. Assembler et cuire les zucchinis farcis", "@type": "HowToSection", "itemListElement": [{"text": "Disposer les moitiés de zucchini, côté coupé vers le haut, sur une plaque recouverte de parchemin. Farcir avec la garniture. Déposer le fromage sur le dessus. Enfourner 16 à 20 min, jusqu'à ce que le fromage soit doré et que les zucchinis aient ramolli.", "@type": "HowToStep"}]}, {"name": "5. Faire la salade et servir", "@type": "HowToSection", "itemListElement": [{"text": "Dans un grand bol, mélanger le vinaigre et 3 tablespoon d'huile d'olive; S-P. Incorporer la laitue. Répartir les zucchinis farcis et la salade entre les assiettes. Bon appétit!", "@type": "HowToStep"}]}]}

name: Spaghetti with Toasted Garlic Bread
description: This dish consists of spaghetti tossed in marinara sauce and served with Italian bread topped with a mixture of butter, garlic, and oregano. The bread is toasted in the oven until the edges are golden, and the pasta is finished with a garnish of grated parmesan cheese. The entire meal takes approximately 30 minutes to prepare from start to finish.

name: Muffin banane chocolat ultra moelleux
description: These muffins are made with mashed ripe bananas, dark chocolate chips, and vanilla Greek yogurt to create a moist texture. The batter is prepared by combining creamed butter and sugar with wet and dry ingredients, then topped with a sprinkle of brown sugar before baking in a conventional oven or air fryer. The process yields ten large muffins with a golden-brown exterior and a soft interior.

name: Crêpes de base
description: This recipe yields thin, lightly sweetened crêpes made from a batter of milk, eggs, flour, sugar, and salt. The ingredients are blended until smooth and then cooked in a buttered non-stick pan until the edges are golden and the surface is set. The finished dish consists of flexible pancakes that can be folded or rolled with various accompaniments.

name: Rouleaux de printemps
description: These spring rolls consist of rice vermicelli, cooked shrimp, julienned mango, and fresh vegetables wrapped in translucent rice paper. Fresh mint leaves provide an aromatic element to the chilled rolls, which are prepared by hand-rolling the softened rice sheets around the fillings. The dish is served with two distinct dipping options: a savory peanut sauce and a creamy sesame-based dressing.

description: This dish features cavatappi pasta tossed with ground beef, sautéed zucchini, and leafy greens in a creamy tomato sauce seasoned with sun-dried tomatoes and Mezzogiorno spices. name: Bols de porc haché au sésame, haricots et carottes sur riz au jasmin au gingembre
description: This dish features ground pork sautéed with green beans and julienned carrots in a sweet soy and sesame seasoning. The preparation involves simmering the rice while pan-frying the meat and vegetables on the stovetop.

name: Korean Bulgogi Chicken with cheesy corn
description: This dish features chicken thighs marinated in a savory-sweet blend of soy sauce, ginger, garlic, and sesame oil, then pan-cooked until the sauce thickens. It is served alongside steamed jasmine rice and a side of corn kernels baked with mayonnaise and melted mozzarella cheese. The meal is finished with a garnish of sliced green onions and toasted sesame seeds.

name: Kraft Dinner with Broccoli
description: This dish combines boxed macaroni and fresh broccoli florets boiled together in a single pot before being drained. The pasta and vegetables are then mixed with butter, milk, and cheese powder to create a smooth cheese sauce. The process yields two portions and takes approximately fifteen minutes to complete.

name: Bacon Corn Chowder
description: This Bacon Corn Chowder is a cream-based soup prepared by simmering Yukon Gold potatoes and corn in a broth thickened with a flour roux and whole milk. The dish is seasoned with dried thyme and garlic, then finished with sharp cheddar cheese and topped with crispy bacon and green onions.

name: KIT DE STEAKS BBQ avec maïs cacio e pepe et pommes de terre rôties
description: This meal features grilled beef top sirloin medallions and corn on the cob served alongside oven-roasted potatoes seasoned with lemon and herbs. name: Janie's Broccoli and Cheese Pasta
description: This dish combines fusilli or penne pasta with fresh broccoli florets in a creamy cheddar cheese sauce. The preparation involves boiling the vegetables and pasta together before tossing them in a homemade roux-based sauce made from butter, flour, milk, and shredded cheese. Seasoned simply with salt and pepper, this meal provides a straightforward vegetarian option that can be prepared in approximately 25 minutes.

description: This no-cook breakfast dish consists of rolled oats soaked in low-fat chocolate milk and topped with sliced bananas, strawberries, and walnuts. The mixture requires at least eight hours of refrigeration to soften the oats and integrate the fruit and cocoa flavors. The final result is a chilled, multi-textured meal featuring fruit and nutty accents.

name: Poitrines de poulet et fusillis aux tomates séchées avec salade à la vinaigrette balsamique

name: Mini Beef Kofta Bowl
description: This dish consists of pan-seared ground beef patties seasoned with a blend of cumin, coriander, cinnamon, and smoked paprika. The koftas are served over basmati rice alongside a fresh salad of Boston lettuce, cucumbers, and cherry tomatoes. A lemon-herb Greek yogurt sauce and crumbled feta cheese are added as final toppings.

name: Pizzas au poulet BBQ sur naans avec salade de bébé laitue et pommes
description: These pizzas consist of naan bread topped with chicken strips sautéed in BBQ sauce, shredded mozzarella, and sliced shallots. name: Pork Wonton Soup with bok choy
description: This recipe features wontons filled with ground pork, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, and chili flakes, served in a chicken broth seasoned with soy sauce and aromatics. The dish is prepared by simmering the broth and boiling the dumplings alongside blanched Shanghai bok choy. Fresh green onions are used both in the broth infusion and as a final garnish.

description: This dish features layers of lasagna noodles, shredded chicken, and a white sauce seasoned with garlic and oregano. name: Boulettes de viande à la suédoise
description: These Swedish-style meatballs are prepared with a blend of ground beef and pork seasoned with allspice and onions. The meatballs are pan-seared and then simmered in a creamy gravy made from beef broth, cream, Dijon mustard, and Worcestershire sauce. This dish is traditionally served over mashed potatoes to incorporate the savory sauce.

name: Pâté Chinois
description: Pâté Chinois is a layered dish that consists of ground beef sautéed with onions, a layer of creamed and kernel corn, and a topping of mashed potatoes. The assembly is seasoned with paprika and baked until the top is golden. This recipe provides a combination of meat, corn, and potato textures in a single-pan format.

name: Boulettes de bœuf en sauce maïs-poivrons crémeuse sur purée de pommes de terre rustique
description: This meal consists of pan-seared beef meatballs seasoned with garlic and a spice blend of cumin, paprika, and oregano, served over a rustic buttered potato mash. The meatballs are finished in a creamy sauce made from beef demi-glace, fresh corn kernels, and diced bell peppers. The preparation requires boiling the potatoes while browning the meat and sautéing the vegetables in a separate skillet.
